findings.description: No server_side_encryption_configuration block is defined, so objects (including the uploaded vendor roster) are stored without an enforced default encryption policy using SSE-KMS.

The bucket declares no ACL and no public access block or bucket policy, leaving access control to defaults and providing no explicit guarantee that the bucket is private; combined with the seeded vendor roster object this risks data exposure.
No logging block is configured, so read/write access to this bucket containing vendor data is not recorded, hindering detection and forensic investigation of unauthorised access.
The ledger exports bucket has no server_side_encryption_configuration, so sensitive financial export data is stored without enforced default SSE-KMS encryption.
No logging block is configured for this financial data bucket, so access to ledger exports is not auditable.
No server_side_encryption_configuration is present, so model artifacts are stored without enforced default encryption at rest.

The runbooks bucket lacks server_side_encryption_configuration; operational runbooks frequently contain sensitive procedural and credential-adjacent information and are stored unencrypted by default policy.
No logging block is configured, so access to operational runbooks is not recorded for audit or intrusion detection.

findings.issue_category: missing access logging on audit store
findings.description: The bucket that receives audit and access logs has no logging configuration of its own, so tampering with or access to the audit trail itself is not recorded.

force_destroy = true on the audit log bucket allows the bucket and all retained log objects to be deleted in a single Terraform operation, undermining the integrity and non-repudiation of the audit trail (no object lock or MFA delete is configured).
Versioning is not enabled and force_destroy is true, so objects can be overwritten or destroyed irrecoverably, removing protection against malicious or accidental data destruction.
Versioning is not enabled while force_destroy is true, leaving financial ledger exports with no protection against malicious overwrite or deletion.
